title: peer_node clone before tokio::spawn: correct ownership pattern
description: Cloning caller.identity.node_name before the tokio::spawn move closure (events.rs:317) is the correct pattern. The alternative — cloning the full Caller struct — would require Caller to be Send + 'static and bring WhoIsResponse into the spawn, adding unnecessary coupling. Capturing only the needed string (node_name) is the minimal-capture idiom for spawn closures. A future contributor might suggest 'just clone the caller instead' which would tighten coupling. The current approach is right.
